Defeat the Fragment of Seren. Protect from Ranged, and keep your distance. She is only susceptible to magic damage, so bring your best magic gear. If she moves you close to her and locks you in place, she is about to hit 99% of your max health. Eat up. If she spawns a healing spell, attack it to destroy it.
